text.p: StorMedia Inc Chief Executive Officer William Almon Thursday said the company signed a letter of intent Wednesday night to sell computer disk drive components to an unidentified disk drive maker.

Almon told investors at the Montgomery Securities Conference here the new customer could replace half the revenue StorMedia lost when Maxtor Corp, formerly StorMedia's second largest customer, cancelled its contract. In September, StorMedia said it filed a lawsuit against Maxtor and its parent company Hyundai Electronics of America.
StorMedia makes metallic disks that store computer information.
Disk drive manufacturers buy these thin filmed disks to assemble complete drives for personal computers.
Maxtor in the third quarter accounted for about 23 percent of StorMedia's estimated $41 million revenue, or about $9.4 million.
